name: StillTabs
tagline: Instagram and YouTube without Reels or Shorts
analytics: Off unless the user turns them on
homeScreenIcons: Icons named after each platform that open StillTabs, no Screen Time permission needed

whyStillTabs.detail: No subscription, no trial, no in-app purchases, no ads. 11 of 14 Reels blockers and screen-time apps we checked sell a subscription; some bill weekly.
App Store label "Data Not Linked to You"; analytics off until the user turns them on. 7 of 14 apps checked carry "Data Used to Track You".
stilltabs.com makes no third-party requests; several rivals load advertising pixels with no cookie banner.
Reels, Shorts, Explore and suggested posts go; messages, stories, search and followed accounts stay. Whole-app blockers lock DMs too.
No Screen Time access, no screen broadcast, no device management, no Safari extension.
Home Screen icons named Instagram, YouTube and so on open StillTabs, without Screen Time.
Natively drawn Instagram toolbar, tabs kept loaded, edge-swipe gestures.
Off, Standard, Strict and Blackout; rivals put strict modes and longer blocks behind Pro.
Up to five accounts per platform.
Pages load straight from each platform; no proxy, so passwords and messages never pass through StillTabs.

userFeedback.note: Messages people sent us through the feedback form inside the StillTabs app, October and November 2026, quoted word for word. They are anonymous. We chose these; nobody was paid or asked to write them.
